programmes.d: Dren continues her attack on San Diego. Something is going on between Angelina and Vinny. And, when the roommates take a trip to San Diego's Little Italy, they're surprised to find the ultimate Guido waiting for them - Uncle Nino.

Deena's "Family Fun Day" has Angelina struggling in the wake of her failed marriage. Jenni lands in the emergency room. And Nick Cannon and Justina Valentine lead the squad in an impromptu game of "Wild 'N Out." May the funniest guido win!
Water turns into wine and in the blink of an eye, it's pure chaos between Pauly, Nikki, and Angelina.
Deena is still wondering if last night's showdown was all a prank, while the rest of the roomies are wondering, "Where do we go from here?" Meanwhile, Vinny plans a day in his honor.
Vinny throws an epic party on the last night of the family vacation, filled with carbs, strip clubs and a late night rendezvous no one saw coming. See ya, San Diego!

TV's greatest Italian family returns to the reunion stage and they're not holding back... is Angeliners finally divorced? Is old Sitch gone forever? Tacos and dramers are on the menu in Part 1 of the Jersey Shore Family Vacation reunion!

Your favorite roommates aren't done yet! Vinny and Angelina get spicy, the Meatballs embrace their wild side, and tensions get so hot one roommate leaves to cool off. The party continues tonight with Part 2 of the Jersey Shore reunion!

The roommates rally around Mike as he says goodbye to his beloved dog, Mosey. Deena's on edge because Angelina's been hanging out with her brother-in-law. And the fam gets a big surprise when they hit the Shore for DJ Pauly D's gig at Headliners.

Snooki turns Deena, Angelina and JWoww into a cheer squad. Mike channels Rocky as he trains for the Super Hole 3 Corn Hole Championships, but Angelina inadvertently jeopardizes his chance for the win. And the fam heads south for the big event.
Just an ordinary day at the lake, filled with boating, drinking, fighting, lap dancing...and a revelation that leaves the roomies speechless.

What's next for Angelina after revealing her true feelings for Vinny? And, in the words of Pauly D, a game of truth or dare gets "Awkward." Plus, the cornhole finals are here and The Situation is ready for Jay Cutler.
Mike wants to win it all, Prickly Elder wants to go to bed, Snooki wants to start a fire, and Angelina wants Vinny. But what does Vinny want?

Vinny invites Angelina to his apartment... is it a date? Nicole invites the girls to California for a business trip/wild weekend in wine country, and the Keto Guido is invited to dance with the stars.

On the eve of the Dancing with the Stars premiere, Pauly and Mike travel to LA to support Vinny. Meanwhile, a girls' weekend in wine country goes off the rails when Meatball Merlot meets a Danish beer festival.
Vinny dances, Mike makes some questionable fashion choices, and the upcoming family vacation to New Orleans is about to be taken over by beef between Angelina and Mike.
The guidos come marching into New Orleans for a family vacation. The dirty stayouts are bringing a lot of wine, and Mike and Angelina are bringing a lot of baggage and beef.

Mike continues his battle with Angelina over their Twitter war, meanwhile Pauly and Vinny hatch a plan to give Mike the gender reveal of his dreams: 10,000 ft in the air. The only problem is making sure Lauren doesn't find out before he jumps.

Deena's jazz night with costumes is only outdone when she plans another Family Fun Day with matching shirts. Plus, Angelina invites her new boyfriend on vacation, but will her Twitter beef with Mike ruin her man's introduction to the family?
Angelina's new man arrives just in time for her divorce party. Snooki burns Ang's wedding dress. Pauly takes everyone to the hauntedest house ever. And Deena makes it clear she's not afraid of JWOWW.
The Dirty Stay Outs give Angelina's new man quite the Jersey Shore initiation. It's Vinny's birthday, and he's ready for his long overdue party. But it looks like he might be disappointed yet again.
The roommates are shocked when Vinny's birthday party unexpectedly turns into Angelina's engagement party. But what's even more unexpected is what happens after Angelina says yes.
The aftermath of Angelina's surprise engagement leaves her and Jenni at odds, and Mike "The Mediation" steps in. But it backfires, and now the trip is about to end.

The Jersey Shore Family is back to break down another epic vacation. The shoremates break down all the big moments from this season and Angelina unexpectedly sounds off on her roommates. We love reunions this time of year!

The reunion and the Mardi Gras madness continue! The girls' friendships are in jeopardy, Vinny gets sentimental, and the fans put the crew in the hot seat. It all goes down on part two of the reunion!

Since the Jersey Shore squad started taking family vacations, there have been 14 trips and a lifetime of memories. But throughout their adventures, they have always felt like something was missing. Now that's all about to change with one sweet return.
